description: This file is an HTML source file that defines the structure and styles of a web-based database viewer UI. It includes embedded JavaScript code that manages fetching database, table, and data information via API calls, as well as rendering data tables and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the UI to the initial state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables within a selected database and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays HTML table elements for the data set.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects, toggling display.
